summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader without running any repository code and without committing. Files: monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (new; load_decathalon_datalist plus private _resolve_path, stdlib os/json only), monai/data/__init__.py (explicit export), docs/source/data.rst (Decathalon DataLoader subsection with tilde underline and autofunction entry), tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py (new; TestLoadDecathalonDatalist with test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, test_seg_no_labels; temp dir removed in tearDown). Static checks only: no lines over 120 characters, docs underline length matches the title. Choices beyond the spec: a non-list value under data_list_key raises ValueError; output items are shallow copies; a non-object top-level JSON value is treated as a missing key; the file check uses os.path.isfile. Tests have not been run.
